design_decisions.which_shelf: User said 'prima grila' = meat, 'a doua grila' = mushrooms. Interpreted top-down: first shelf = top shelf (surface y 19 local, about 0.96 m above the floor, comfortable VR height), second = next one down (y 13, about 0.66 m). Make the shelf surface heights constants at the top of the editor tool so the user can swap them.
design_decisions.taken_means: An item counts as taken when (a) the player grabs it (XRGrabInteractable.selectEntered), or (b) it is destroyed (sliced in place), or (c) it is found farther than a leave distance (default 0.12 m) from the slot pose (pushed out by hand). The slot then waits RespawnDelay seconds (default 5) and spawns a fresh item at the same slot pose, but only when no physical body (non-trigger collider with attachedRigidbody != null) overlaps the slot's check sphere, so an item still held in place or put back on the spot never produces a duplicate on top of it. One slot never holds two items. Clones made by the knife slicer carry no slot component, so halves never cause extra spawns.
design_decisions.spawn_parent: Items are instantiated unparented (scene root) so the 0.05 scale of the fridge does not leak into them.

grab_distance_findings.simulator: XR Device Simulator (sample prefab, m_KeyboardZTranslateSpeed 0.2 m/s): Left Shift / Space = manipulate left/right controller, then W/S (Keyboard Z Translate) moves the simulated controller forward/back, and also drives Controller 'Axis 2D' (thumbstick) in the controller action map.
grab_distance_findings.xri_source: Library/PackageCache/com.unity.xr.interaction.toolkit@8a8cfde33e41/Runtime/Interaction/Attachment/InteractionAttachController.cs. Defaults: useDistanceBasedVelocityScaling true, useMomentum true, minAdditionalVelocityScalar 0.05, maxAdditionalVelocityScalar 1.5, zVelocityRampThreshold 0.3, pullVelocityBias 1, pushVelocityBias 1.25, momentumDecayScale 1.25, manipulationTranslateSpeed 1, useManipulationInput false. ComputeAmplifiedOffset: movement = zMotion * rampAmount * (1 + movementScale) * dt with movementScale = lerp(min*pivot, max*pivot, t), pivot = current distance, so far objects are pulled up to about 5.5x faster than the hand; momentum keeps pulling after input stops; DoPositionUpdate calls ResetOffset (object snaps into the hand) when the new offset dot start offset < 0.05. Public IInteractionAttachController API usable in tests: GetOrCreateAnchorTransform, MoveTo, DoUpdate(deltaTime), hasOffset, ResetOffset.
